decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:E00E01E02E03E04P00P01P02P03P04P05P06Flood Risk AssessmentReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time acting as a single household and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen / dining rooms shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the amenity of neighbours and the residential character of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the provision of six long-stay cycle parking spaces within the front garden have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and thereafter retained for that purpose. These details should demonstrate: Location: within the front garden  Design: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered and secure Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

The development shall not commence until details of the proposed means of enclosure to the site frontage, including details of access to the cycle parking facilities, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall demonstrate that a minimum unobstructed access width of 1.2m is provided to the cycle parking area and that any enclosure adjacent to the vehicular access does not exceed 0.6m in height within 2m of the access point in the interests of visibility and highway safety. The approved details shall be implemented in full prior to first occupation of the development and thereafter retained as approved.Reason: In the interests of highway safety and accessibility

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.
